title: KaamKaro (K) is slowing servers w1, w3, w8 with hidden background work

context.summary: KaamKaro's bulk-ingest requests trigger about 9x more work in the black-box indexer than they are billed for. Its 3 servers (w1, w3, w8) slowed down. The 9 tenants sharing those servers were moved to healthy servers in 0.9 s. Moving KaamKaro to the spare server made w1, w3 and w8 recover (R = 0.78), and the slowdown followed KaamKaro to the spare. Genuineness 34%, importance Medium (Pro, Rs 1.8 lakh/month).

pending_actions.text: Approve moving KaamKaro's bulk-ingest requests (POST /api/ingest) to the heavy lane. Its other requests keep flowing normally.
Notify KaamKaro's engineering contact with the evidence and the suggested fix (batch the ingest calls).
